findings.issue: Tagged noun proper with a 3ms suffix, not a plural common noun; «asherás» pluralizes it and transliterates it as a common noun.
The first two suffixes are 3mp and the third is 3ms; repeated «sus» does not show that possessor-number change.
H4676 is a standing pillar or stone; «estelas» can narrow it to an inscribed stele.

notes: 2mp imperfects as ustedes futures are licensed; את is left untranslated.
